instruction: My grandfather struggles with reading tiny text on websites. Please configure Chrome to prevent any text from displaying smaller than 10 pixels by setting the minimum font size.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting minimum font size in Chrome to at least 10 pixels to prevent tiny text. Evaluator checks if minimum_font_size >= 10. Uses custom getter to extract minimum_font_size from Chrome preferences and custom metric to validate the range.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: minimum font size must be at least 10 pixels
Getter logic correctly extracts minimum_font_size from Chrome preferences file (webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size) across all OS types (Windows, macOS, Linux)
Metric logic correctly validates that minimum_font_size is within the range [10, 99999], which semantically means >= 10 pixels
Expected value configuration is correct: range [10, 99999] accurately represents 'at least 10 pixels' requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preference changes are persisted and readable from the Preferences file
Data flow is correct: getter extracts numeric value -> metric compares against numeric range -> passes if >= 10
State accessibility is ensured: Chrome preferences persist across restarts, so the getter can reliably read the saved setting
Complete coverage: the single requirement in the instruction (minimum font size >= 10) is fully verified by the evaluator
